title: JANUS Linear A canonical research state after numeric typing correction, SigLA parser admission, replay-confirmed blind-role negative, morphology negative, and formula-neighborhood negative

canonicality.rule: v2.5 extends v2.4 with the completed R3 provenance gate and the subsequently executed SigLA R3A technical/scientific chain. Earlier receipts remain immutable historical evidence and are not retroactively rewritten.

registry_architecture.data_rule: Frozen specs, receipts, results, reconciliations, governance corrections, canonical state and roadmaps remain under data/.

source_independence_state.why: SigLA has an independent software/digitization/palaeographic database layer but overlapping legacy transcription decisions remain tied to the GORILA tradition. It can falsify parser/digitization artifacts, not establish L3 external transcription replication.

v0.8 higher-order typed neighborhoods with supplementary implementation convergence
R3A SigLA technical adapter and unit-reference validation

authoritative_evidence_chain.strongest_raw_near_miss: AB41 / visible si / PREFIX / raw p≈0.003665 / Bonferroni p≈0.12829

governance_ledger_delta.lesson: Representation corrections must target a grammatical token class, not only the first discovered leaking literal.
A stable technical word-view route does not by itself establish a universal content-unit DOM schema. Interface identity and extraction grammar are distinct gates.

governance_ledger_delta.correction: A separately frozen strict ordinal audit tested word-N against index-word-N.html and passed 19/19 without repairing the failed fragment hypothesis posthoc.
governance_ledger_delta.lesson: Failed structural hypotheses must be preserved; corrective relations require a new predeclared gate.

governance_ledger_delta.correction: A concurrency-safe v0.1.1 recovery re-executed the complete frozen preflight and produced a fresh independent Actions receipt before persistence.
governance_ledger_delta.lesson: Registry write races are infrastructure failures, not scientific failures, and PASS must not be transferred across runs without a new receipt.

governance_ledger_delta.correction: The original result was preserved as PRE_ADMISSION_EXECUTION and was not retroactively admitted. The exact frozen experiment was replayed after admission and its complete scientific projection reproduced exactly.
governance_ledger_delta.lesson: Temporal ordering of admission and claim-bearing execution matters; later validation should trigger a replay, not retroactive relabeling.
A visually or linguistically interesting raw p-value is not a survivor when the predeclared corrected threshold fails.
A valid negative can arise at the frozen eligibility layer. Zero eligible hypotheses is evidence about structural support under that ontology, not permission to lower thresholds.

methodological_connections.name: GENERIC_TYPE_SYSTEMS_PREVENT_LEXICAL_LEAKAGE
methodological_connections.statement: Exact, approximate and uncertain numeric literals must be typed before lexical candidate construction so notation cannot masquerade as a word identity.

methodological_connections.name: TECHNICAL_PARSER_INTEGRITY_CAN_BE_PROOF_CARRYING_WITHOUT_BEING_A_SCIENTIFIC_DISCOVERY
methodological_connections.statement: The 686/686 SigLA preflight can admit a parser while its own claim ceiling remains non-lexical and non-decipherment.

methodological_connections.name: THREE_REPRESENTATIONS_CAN_CROSS_VALIDATE_A_SOURCE_NATIVE_COUNT
methodological_connections.statement: Reported word counts, machine seq-pattern anchors, and source-native word-N/index-word-N structures agreed on all 686 bridged documents under the frozen parser-integrity contract.

methodological_connections.name: REPLAY_AFTER_ADMISSION_IS_STRONGER_THAN_RETROACTIVE_ADMISSION
methodological_connections.statement: The R3A_4 scientific projection was reproduced exactly only after the parser admission existed, preserving causal ordering without rewriting the first execution.

methodological_connections.name: RAW_NEAR_MISS_IS_NOT_A_LOCKED_CANDIDATE
methodological_connections.statement: AB41/si produced an interesting raw morphology signal but failed the frozen multiplicity correction and therefore generated no candidate promotion.

methodological_connections.name: STRUCTURAL_SPARSITY_CAN_BE_THE_RESULT
methodological_connections.statement: The directed formula ontology produced zero eligible SCREEN pair hypotheses despite hundreds of eligible adjacency instances; a gate can falsify sufficient recurrence before any null permutation is run.

methodological_connections.name: SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE_IS_LAYERED_NOT_BINARY
methodological_connections.statement: SigLA supplies independent digitization/parser evidence at L1 but remains insufficient for L3 external transcription replication.

highest_admissible_claim: The generic numeric-literal typing correction removes fractional/approximate numeric notation from lexical candidate leakage without producing a new cross-region survivor. On 686 collision-free SigLA↔mwenge document identities, a fail-closed SigLA parser passed all 686 source-native integrity checks. After that admission, the frozen SigLA blind-role experiment exactly reproduced its prior scientific projection and retained zero full survivors; the separately frozen one-sign morphology test selected zero of 35 SCREEN hypotheses after correction; and the directed formula-neighborhood test produced zero SCREEN-eligible pair hypotheses at its frozen support thresholds. These are robust same/shared-transcription and cross-digitization negatives, not external transcription replication, and they establish neither a new lexical anchor nor decipherment.
current_research_question: Can any locked structural relation survive on a genuinely independent L3 transcription baseline, or can a new predeclared behavioral/material/layout channel provide evidence not reducible to another transformation of the same transcription tradition?

roadmap.action: Locate or obtain machine-readable CTLA/TMT/RILA material or independently transcribe a predeclared overlapping subset from an alternate editorial corpus. Freeze provenance and overlap before any candidate-level evaluation.
roadmap.forbidden: Do not infer L3 independence from a different website, file format, parser or interface.

roadmap.action: Design a separately frozen channel based on inscription layout, object/material class, spatial ordering or other metadata whose evidential content is not merely another encoding of the same word transcription. Freeze ontology and null model before inspecting candidate-specific outcomes.
roadmap.forbidden: Do not use this route to re-test AB41/si, ku-ro or any prior near-miss under looser thresholds.

roadmap.action: Implement source-specific parser/normalizer preserving disagreements rather than coercing them to mwenge/SigLA identities.
Freeze locked hypotheses, identity bridge and transforms before any true external transcription replication test.
